fr.recommendations:
• Install a clearly visible address marker at the driveway entrance that is readable from the road in both directions.
• Mark the detached structure with a unit or structure identifier so responders can distinguish it from the main residence during a call.
• Post the property address on the detached structure as well as the main residence.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive so vehicles can pass without obstruction on both sides.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach both structures without repositioning.
• Identify and mark any secondary foot path to the rear of the property so responders are not limited to a single route on arrival.
• Keep a gate or opening accessible at the rear or side of the property to allow responders to reach areas not served by the main access drive.
• Thin dense vegetation between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without pushing through overgrowth.
• Mark the location of the main electrical disconnect and solar system shutoff on the exterior of the residence so responders can locate them quickly.
• Label the solar system shutoff with the panel brand and shut-down procedure, or post a laminated instruction card next to the disconnect.
• Keep the area around the solar system disconnect clear of stored items and equipment.
• Designate a flat, open staging area near the access drive where responders can set down equipment without

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches on large trees that hang directly over or close to the house and any outbuildings.
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to the structure to create open spacing between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the base of the structure.
• Clear ground vegetation within a few feet of the house, detached structures, and any decks or porches.
• Separate scattered shrubs from nearby scattered trees so fire cannot easily move between them toward the structure.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along both sides.
• Cut back any vegetation that narrows or blocks the driveway to maintain room for a fire truck to pass through.
• Clear vegetation and debris from the rear of the property to allow movement around the structure.
• Remove dead or dry ground vegetation under tree clusters near the structure.
• Keep the area under large trees near the house clear of shrubs and accumulated debris at ground level.
